package.name: simulation
package.description: AMR-X simulation assets: the indoor warehouse world (floors, walls, aisles, racks, obstacles, loading/delivery/docking zones), a parametric world generator, and the ROS-Gazebo bridge configuration. Defaults to Gazebo Harmonic with ROS 2 Jazzy and keeps Gazebo Fortress with ROS 2 Humble as a compatibility path via ros_gz.
package.author: ZEYNEB (ROS 2 Integration Lead)
mouhamed bouzidi (Digital Twin Lead)
